text.tspan: An arrow points from a folder to one it imports: solid when the import loads with the
module (eager), dashed when a getter or a call loads it later (lazy).
Grey: down the layers, as ADR-026 allows.
An arrow to a band: imports that many of its folders.
Orange: the 17 upward imports tools/layering/layers.ts lists, one arrow per pair of folders (#936 removes them).
Eager cycle, closed only by orange arrows: about/, actors/, config/, ctl/, host/, workspaces/.
vimma.js imports every folder drawn here.
core/ is imported by every folder drawn here except omarchy/ and start/.
